title: Application by Eastern Edison Company under the provisions of M. G. L. c. 164, Sec. 95G and the Company's tariff, Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the months of December, 1988 and January and February, 1989. The Oil Conservation Adjustment charge is designed to recover the cost of conversion from oilfired to coal-fired generation, and its calulation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and burning oil.
